_comment: Single source of truth for LLM model choices exposed to users and admins. Consumed by gpt (user Settings > LLM API Keys) and gpt_admin (Global Settings > LLM providers, and Packages editor). Prices are USD per 1M tokens. When editing: keep the active-per-provider entry's prices in sync with system_llm_settings DB rows; admins can adjust via Global Settings which writes to the DB.
